Volume ratio below 1 for five consecutive days suggests contraction. 52-week position at 77.3% indicates a pullback phase from highs. 5-day low ($519.80) matches 20-day low ($519.80), and 5-day high ($530.39) shows a downtrend against the 20-day high ($537.73). Volume ratio of 0.61 relative to the 5-day average indicates weak trading activity. 4-hour RSI at 41.6 continues its decline. Weekly RSI at 59.4 maintains an uptrend, but daily signals a potential bearish shift.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($524.90) vs SMA5 ($524.71)/SMA20 ($530.86)/SMA50 ($528.81): short-term above SMA5, mid-term below SMA20/50, indicating a bearish shift.

· Swing resistance ($527.93): resistance confirmed at Pivot R1 ($535.15).

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.61x): decreased confidence in price movement, contraction phase.
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, meeting conditions for observation.
